card.name: Start of a word after a split
card.fires_on: Short word starts or joiners such as 'b', '-b', 'comp', 'ob' or 'oc' that come right after a prefix like over, low or post. The rest of the word follows next (e.g. breathe, birth, licated, bezoar).

modes.label: b after a prefix
modes.description: A 'b' or '-b' piece starting the second half of a compound like overbreathe, low-birth or post-baseline.
modes.example: If you frequently over<<b>>reathe, you may have hyperv

modes.label: Comp at word start
modes.description: A 'comp' or 'Comp' piece that begins complicated or Complications.
modes.example: 5.2 Surgery and Wound Healing<< Comp>>lications In a controlled clinical study in which

modes.label: Other broken-up words
modes.description: Short pieces inside rarer words such as pharmacobezoar, recur, bromide or BOTOX.
modes.example: Endoscopic pharmac<<ob>>ezoar removal has been performed successfully

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the word with a different piece, away from common endings like -ion or -onia.
card.plain: It fires on the opening letters of a word that has been cut into pieces, mostly ones starting with b or comp.
